name: Forcemasc Hospital
source:
Forcemasc Hospital is a short erotic horror visual novel/interactive fiction hybrid. 

Wake up in a hospital, captured by a sexy nurse who is not letting you go until she turns you into a man.
translation:
Forcemasc Hospital是一部简短的色情恐怖视觉小说/互动小说混合体。

在医院醒来，被一名性感护士抓住，她不会放你走，直到她把你变成一个男人。
